notes: Posted 10 November 2001, before Theed Palace (12 December 2001), so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.
Starting (7) as posted: Twi'lek Advisor, You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points, the objective, Deep Hatred, 'Combat Sites', Fear Is My Ally; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'Combat Sites' (one line, counted as two to reach the posted Starting (7)) dested Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core and Naboo: Theed Palace Generator (Dark), the two sites the objective deploys; the strategy sets Vader up 'at the core'.
Posted 'Twelik Advisor (using Nemodian to pull battlegrounds now)' dested Twi'lek Advisor, the starting interrupt; the edit says Neimoidian Advisor is also used to pull battlegrounds.
The comment line '--If I had zuckmann in ship I'd play him' under Ships is not a card and is dropped.
Posted 'Ghkk' dested Ghhhk; 'Alter' and 'Sense' the Premiere Dark interrupts; 'Control' Control (Dark); 'Boba Fett' Boba Fett (Cloud City); 'Arica' the Reflections II Arica.

Posted 'Abyssian Ornament' dested Abyssin Ornament; 'Tauntaun Skill' Tauntaun Skull; 'Froce Field' Force Field; 'Weapon Levatation' Weapon Levitation (Cloud City Dark); 'Nemodian Advisor' Neimoidian Advisor; 'Mara's Lightsaber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'DV, DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul.
Naboo, Naboo Theed Palace Docking Bay and Naboo Battle Plains dested the Dark Coruscant printings.
Edit #1 says a Prepared Defenses is coming in the mail and Imperial Arrest Order and Secret Plans may be added; the list is kept as published.
